name: Big and Big
kurzbeschreibung: Big and Big in Schwaz Discover the Big and Big experience in Schwaz – where tradition meets adventure in the heart of Tirol!
beschreibung: Big and Big in Schwaz is the perfect place for a quick yet delicious bite. Offering a diverse selection of hot and cold snacks, hearty dishes, and sweet treats, there is something here for every palate. The meals are prepared with great care and fresh ingredients - from flavorful sausage specialties to crispy schnitzel burgers and vegetarian options. The friendly team ensures prompt service with a smile. Ideal for a break while exploring the region or a quick lunch on the go, Big and Big offers down-to-earth quality at fair prices in Schwaz.
